chunks: Said (Moses): 'Let your meeting be on the day of the Feast, and let people assemble in broad daylight.'

key_terms.يَوْمَ الزِّينَةِ: The Day of Adornment, a title for the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the 'Day of Adornment' and when does the assembly of people occur according to Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a divine promise where the 'Day of Adornment' signifies the glorification of the faithful and the humiliation of the disbelievers, with the 'forenoon' (Duha) symbolizing the clarity of truth after the darkness of worldly life. The gathering at mid-morning reflects the time when the sun is fully risen, representing the peak of divine justice and the manifestation of God's power. This timing also resonates with the concept of 'Zuhd' (detachment) and the spiritual awakening expected of believers in preparation for the final reckoning.
